title: Wynnic Friends
description: A small modpack made to play on the Wynncraft Minecraft server. Has a lot of QoL and performance mods installed.
body:
![Wynnic Friends Heading](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e5a72304be5a6685f900a977b0566dfb05d07fc0.png)
Wynnic Friends is a lightweight, performance-focused modpack designed specifically for playing on the Wynncraft Minecraft server.

Whether you're questing through Ragni, grinding dungeons with friends, or exploring the far corners of Gavel, this pack enhances your experience with carefully selected optimization mods and Wynncraft-specific quality-of-life improvements. All while staying fully server-friendly.


### 🚀 Optimized Performance

- Wynnic Friends includes performance-enhancing mods to ensure:
  
- Higher FPS
  
- Smoother gameplay
  
- Reduced stuttering and lag
  
- Faster loading times

Perfect for both low-end systems and players who want maximum stability.

### 🗺️ Built for Wynncraft

This modpack focuses entirely on improving the Wynncraft experience:

Clearer and more readable UI

Helpful gameplay enhancements tailored to Wynncraft mechanics

Quality-of-life improvements for quests, combat, and exploration

No unnecessary extras, just what you need for Wynncraft.

### 🔒 Server-Friendly & Compliant

Wynnic Friends is designed exclusively for use on Wynncraft and does not include cheats or unfair advantages.
Always make sure to review Wynncraft’s official rules regarding allowed modifications.

### ❓ FAQ
**Is this modpack allowed on Wynncraft?**

Yes. The pack only includes optimization and quality-of-life mods. It does not contain cheats or gameplay-altering advantages. However, always review Wynncraft’s official rules to ensure compliance.

**Does this modpack change gameplay mechanics?**

No. Wynnic Friends does not modify Wynncraft’s core gameplay. It only improves performance and usability on the client side.

**Can I use this modpack on other servers?**

Technically yes, but it is specifically configured and optimized for Wynncraft. Some features may not be useful outside of Wynncraft.

**Will this improve my FPS?**

In most cases, yes. The included optimization mods are designed to increase FPS, reduce lag spikes, and improve overall stability — especially on lower-end PCs.

**Do I need a powerful computer to run this?**

No. The pack is lightweight and intended to run smoothly even on modest systems.

**Can I add more mods?**

You can, but adding unsupported mods may affect performance or potentially break compatibility with Wynncraft. Add additional mods at your own discretion.
